environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The RDS PostgreSQL instance uses a custom pg_hba.conf entry restricting the 'app_reports' role connections to require clientcert=verify-full with CN matching 'ecs-report-svc'. The database role 'app_reports' is configured with: (1) connection_limit = 5, (2) statement_timeout = '800ms', and (3) the role is granted membership in 'restricted_reader' which has a row-level security policy on all finance schema tables enforcing current_user = submitter_role. Additionally, the PostgreSQL instance has pg_stat_statements loaded and a custom event trigger (ddl_command_start) that terminates sessions issuing non-SELECT DML. The critical control: the 'app_reports' role has been configured via ALTER ROLE with set search_path = 'finance' and the role has NO permissions on pg_catalog or information_schema (REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA pg_catalog FROM app_reports; REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA information_schema FROM app_reports). The pg_hba.conf also sets a per-connection parameter: options='-c default_transaction_read_only=on -c lock_timeout=100ms'. The ALB has an associated WAFv2 WebACL but it only contains AWS-AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList and a rate-limit rule (2000 req/5min) — no SQLi rule set.

config.load_balancer: ALB with WAFv2 (IP reputation + rate limit only, NO SQLi rules)
config.compute: ECS Fargate, Tomcat 9.0.62, JDK 11, task role with no extra permissions
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14.3 with custom pg_hba.conf requiring mTLS (verify-full, CN=ecs-report-svc)

db_role_config.row_level_security: enabled on all finance tables, policy: submitter_role = current_user

config.waf_note: WAFv2 WebACL does NOT include SQLi managed rule group
